conflicts: Two WhatsApp numbers on every page: the footer icon goes to +62 815-8641-7127, while the floating 'Chat with us' widget, the retreat hub's 5 'Discuss a Booking Time' buttons, the Amelia booking sidebar and 5 of 6 Amelia locations use +62 813-3659-182. The 0815 number otherwise appears only on the internal 'Collaborators Only' location. Owner must confirm which is primary.
The T&C says 'All booking communications will be handled via WhatsApp', but the thank-you page says 'we will confirm shortly by email', and Amelia sends confirmations from bookings@balibliss.net.

Three public emails with no stated roles: bookings@ (Amelia sender and sidebar only), info@ (privacy requests only) and lia@ (partnerships; also BCC on every Amelia notification). No general contact email appears in the footer.

Locations: the T&C names 2 venues (Mayu House, Wana Stay) and gives no addresses. Amelia offers 6 options, including Singakerta (Evina Villa) and in-villa visits in Kuta/Seminyak/Kerobokan. Wana Stay is '15 min outside center' in Amelia but 'approx. 10–15 minutes' in the T&C.
Wana Stay vs 'Mas': the Google review widget calls it 'Bali Bliss Wellness Mas', the Amelia name is 'Bali Bliss Mas @Wana Stay', and the T&C says 'Wana Stay – Just Outside Ubud Center'.
The Amelia 'Online - Google Meet' location has placeholder coordinates (40.748441, -73.987853, New York); harmless, but do not reuse them.
No page publishes a street address in visible copy. The Mayu House address (Jalan Raya Ubud No.888) exists only in the Amelia location data and the /bookings/ map pin.
